data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that generates a simple speech balloon with customizable borders and nip locations.
data.what_it_does: Generates customizable speech balloon widgets that can be used for tooltips or pop-up notifications. It allows positioning the nip in various locations and supports adding borders and custom styling.
use_when: You need to display a speech bubble or tooltip UI element in your app.
You want to customize the nip location, border color, and border width of a speech balloon.
avoid_when: You need complex state management or non-widget utilities.
You are looking for fully featured chart or map components.
strengths: Provides multiple nip placement options (top, bottom, left, right, corners).
Supports customizable borders, colors, and border widths.
weaknesses: Limited to basic speech balloon shapes and styling.
Changelog is sparse and documentation is minimal beyond the README.
data.minimal_example:
SpeechBalloon(
  nipLocation: NipLocation.bottom,
  borderColor: Colors.red,
  color: Colors.white,
  child: Icon(
    Icons.favorite,
    color: Colors.red,
  ),
)
